newsitem.title: CHINA: Yuan closes up slightly against US dollar.
newsitem.headline: Yuan closes up slightly against US dollar.

text.p: The Chinese yuan closed up slightly at 8.3015 against the U.S. dollar on Thursday from last Saturday's 8.3017 on the Shanghai-based interbank foreign exchange market after China's National Day holiday.
The yuan opened up at 8.3015 and hit an intra-day high of 8.3005 early in the session, then fell back to move around 8.3010, hitting a low of 8.3018.
Trading was more active than last Saturday, with most done at about 8.3015, traders said.
Dealers said that the yuan moved in a range of 8.3020 and 8.3000, and tried to test the key 8.3000 resistance level.

"The strong performance of the U.S. dollar in the world market had little impact on the yuan, which is still moving up," one dealer said. "But selling as it approached 8.3000 was so heavy today that it fell back quite a way from that level."
Dealers expect the yuan to consolidate below 8.3000 on Friday.
The yuan closed up at 7.4250 from 7.5000 against 100 Japanese yen and slightly down at 1.0730 from 1.0724 against the Hong Kong dollar.
